metaTitle: Build your own kind of strong
metaDescription: A home for your workout programs. Discover the LeoLifter concept: create, follow and grow, in your browser and, in the future, Telegram.
eyebrow: A little structure. A stronger you.
intro: A space to create workout programs, find your rhythm, and make every session count. Built for the way you move.
heroNote: Made for your browser. With Telegram on the horizon.
previewNote: Try a day. Check off an exercise. Get a feel for what’s ahead.
featuresIntro: Whether you follow a plan or make it your own, everything starts with a little structure.
featureOneBody: Follow a workout program that fits your goals, your week, and your starting point.
featureTwoBody: Build your program, arrange your days, and move exercises into a flow that feels right.
featureThreeBody: Keep your sessions and measurements together, so your next step is a little clearer.
platformBody: At your desk, on the gym floor, or on the way there. The vision is one training space that goes with you.
browserBody: A responsive experience, from a big-screen program builder to a phone beside the squat rack.
telegramBody: A future Mini App and bot, connected to your Telegram identity. One familiar place to return to.
roadmapTitle: Good things take a few reps.
roadmapIntro: LeoLifter is taking shape. Here’s the direction, one thoughtful step at a time.
stepOneBody: A first look, five languages, and a home that fits every screen.
stepTwoBody: Create and follow programs, with your workouts and progress in one place.
stepThreeBody: A Mini App and bot with Telegram-linked sign-in and a shared training experience.
footerLine: A little stronger, one session at a time.
themeToggle: Switch between light and dark theme

account.title: Your account
account.subtitle: A few details to make LeoLifter yours.
account.personalNote: Choose how you appear and add the details you want to share. Optional fields can be left blank.
account.countryHint: Two letters, for example UA, GB or NO.
account.timezoneHint: For example Europe/Kyiv. Used for your local times.
account.settingsNote: Choose your language and preferred measurement units.
account.passwordNote: Set or change the password used for nickname sign-in. Each sign-in also requires your approval in Telegram.
account.passwordHint: Use 12–128 characters. Changing or setting a password signs out your other sessions.
account.sessionsNote: Review your sign-ins and revoke access to devices you no longer use. Sessions expire 30 days after sign-in.
account.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Reload the page to sign in again.
account.forbidden: This request could not be verified. Reload and try again.
account.unavailable: Unable to save right now. Please try again.
account.notFound: This session is no longer available. Refresh the page.
account.rateLimited: Too many password attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
account.passwordSaved: Password saved. Your other sessions have been signed out.
account.validationHint: Use a valid date, positive height with up to two decimal places, and a valid time zone.
account.passwordInvalid: Use 12–128 characters and enter the same new password in both fields.

login.title: Sign in to LeoLifter
login.subtitle: Your password, confirmed by you in Telegram.
login.pendingBody: We’re sending a confirmation to your linked Telegram account. Compare the code below, then choose Yes in the bot. Keep this page open.
login.deniedBody: You declined this request in Telegram. No session was created.
login.expiredBody: The request expired, was cancelled, or could not be delivered. Start a new sign-in.
login.invalidCredentials: Unable to sign in with these details. Check your nickname and password, or use Telegram sign-in. Nicknames shared by multiple accounts must be changed through Telegram first.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
login.forbidden: This request could not be verified. Reload the page.
login.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
login.telegramHelp: New here or no password yet? Send /start to LeoBot, open your profile and set a password. Telegram sign-in remains available.
login.passwordHint: Enter the password you set in your profile.
login.privateNote: Only approve a request you started. No blocks this attempt without signing out your existing sessions.
